moat_against: KLA is the dominant process-control rival with far broader portfolio and scale; Nova and Camtek contest the same niches
ROIC proxy only 6.4% in latest FY and 7.1-15.4% in the prior three — not well above cost of capital through a cycle
Gross margin fell from 53.6% (FY2022) to 49.7% (latest FY) — pricing power is contested, not proven
Semiconductor capex cyclicality and customer concentration; China export-control exposure
Goodwill jumped to $644.0M after Semilab — acquisition integration / impairment risk
moat_for: Leading position in advanced-packaging inspection/metrology (Dragonfly G5) riding HBM/AI packaging demand
Tool qualification and process-integration switching costs at fabs and OSATs
Semilab materials-analysis acquisition (closed FY2025, $436.1M acquisitions line) broadens the metrology suite
Debt-free balance sheet: cash $346.1M + short-term investments $293.5M at FY end, no debt tags filed
moat_justification: Niche leadership in advanced-packaging inspection/metrology (Dragonfly) and fab qualification switching costs, but KLA dominates process control, ROIC proxy has run only 6.4-15.4% in the last four fiscal years, and gross margin has slipped from 53.6% to 49.7% — a moderate/narrow moat, not a wide one.
name: ONTO INNOVATION INC.
one_liner: Real AI-packaging growth inflection, moat 5/10 — but at $220.70 the price already discounts the super-bull case: weighted IRR 8.7%, IV@15% $95.88, clears 15% only below $95.88; Tier D.
